channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Federal agencies sued amid allegations Trump admin could be using AI safety framework to hide AI manipulation and corruption
item.description: US government agencies criticized for failing to reveal very many details at all about how its tests the safety of frontier models.

item.title: Google's new AI weather model uses live satellite data for higher-resolution forecasts
item.description: WeatherNext 3 is also supposed to be much better at predicting precipitation.

item.title: GPT-6 is here, but what if we just said 'no thanks' to Astra, a model so powerful that we may never fully understand it
item.description: OpenAI's next big model, Astra, a.k.a. GPT-6, is done with training and ready to launch, but CEO Sam Altman's warning and recent reports on the model's inscrutable nature have us worried.

item.title: Utah won't enforce VPN age-verification law until legal challenge resolves
item.description: The state was the first to target VPN usage in the wake of age verification laws, but an ongoing court case has put things on ice.

item.title: The Cybercab is Tesla’s ‘fork in the road’ moment
item.description: The company is about to formally launch the gold two-seater, with no steering wheel or pedals -- a move that could change Tesla forever.

item.title: Barilla is buying one of America’s fastest-growing mac and cheese brands
item.description: The Italian pasta giant has agreed to acquire GOODLES, the buzzy boxed mac and cheese brand that hit store shelves just over four years ago. A fast-growing maker of nutrient-dense macaroni-and-cheese could soon be elbowing for more shelf space in grocery stores thanks to its acquisition by a pasta powerhouse.

item.title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
item.description: The high-profile startup's annual revenue run rate stands at over $100 million.

item.title: Utilities are racing to link up with fusion startups, with Realta Fusion the latest to benefit
item.description: The grid has been straining under the weight of new AI data centers, and that has utilities courting fusion startups.

item.title: Philips Hue lâche le câble HDMI : une caméra synchronise enfin vos lumières avec n’importe quelle source
item.description: Philips Hue lâche enfin le câble HDMI pour synchroniser vos lumières avec le téléviseur. Une caméra posée sur l'écran remplace le boîtier, et elle fonctionne avec n'importe quelle source.

item.title: Your 401(k) may be at a record high. Think twice before making this money move
item.description: More workers are borrowing from their 401(k)s or taking hardship withdrawals, moves that can come at a significant long-term cost. Even as they feel the squeeze from inflation, workers are saving more than ever.

item.title: Epic Games brings cross-platform voice chat to Fortnite and its services
item.description: Game and yap from across Epic's ecosystem.

item.title: Vénus : ces molécules du vivant ont résisté à une expérience que l’on croyait impossible et relancent la question de la vie
item.description: Et si certaines molécules indispensables au vivant étaient bien plus résistantes qu’on ne le pensait ? Des chercheurs ont découvert que plusieurs peptides peuvent rester stables pendant des semaines dans de l’acide sulfurique presque pur et même adopter des structures tridimensionnelles bien...

item.title: The Grand Tour presenters had Amazon meeting 'days after' Richard Hammond Throttle House cameo on YouTube — 'we had no idea of any details'
item.description: Throttle House fans have called the channel a 'spiritual successor' to Top Gear for years — but The Grand Tour presenters had no idea what was coming when they booked Richard Hammond.

item.title: Anker's 'personal fabric printer' will let you print customs designs on t-shirts and bags — new 'Direct-to-Garment' printing looks perfect for your side hustles
item.description: Anker's latest printer, which is being previewed at IFA 2026, lets you print your designs on fabric or film.

item.title: GPT-6 Astra : OpenAI lance son modèle le plus puissant et annonce « l’ère de l’AGI »
item.description: OpenAI a lancé GPT-6 Astra le 3 septembre, son modèle le plus puissant à ce jour. Son président parle déjà d'« ère de l'AGI », sur la foi de tests que l'entreprise a elle-même notés.

item.title: Beyerdynamic's new Aventho Y headphones last up to 90 hours per charge
item.description: This is especially noteworthy, as the cans cost just $150.
